articles.title: The Phillies haven’t avoided disaster yet. They’ve merely postponed it ... for now
articles.description: They will determine the final words that end up written about these last 10 days. Were they a harbinger? Or were they a rallying point? They will decide.

articles.title: Phillies’ slide continues with loss to Rays as lead over Diamondbacks shrinks to one game
articles.description: With a win on Friday night, the Diamondbacks can move within one game of the Phillies, who could only muster four hits against the Rays, wasting a 10-strikeout outing by Cristopher Sánchez.

articles.title: Led by their stars, the Phillies are back in the playoffs. Anything can happen from here.
articles.description: The Phillies are in the playoffs for a fifth consecutive season, and nothing that happened over the last six months matters anymore. Remember 2022?

articles.title: Phillies’ Luis Arraez leaves game vs. Brewers with a sprained left ankle
articles.description: Arraez tried to dodge a tag at first base and he appeared to twist his ankle and fell to the ground in pain. As the Phillies ’ push for a playoff berth continues, their offense was dealt a blow when ...

articles.title: The Phillies are forced to get creative with their pitching vs. the Braves. Will it work again?
articles.description: In 2023, the Phillies faced a similar pitching conundrum when they opened with Ranger Suárez in Atlanta. The move paid off. They’re hoping it works with Jesús Luzardo in Game 1.

articles.title: Phillies playoffs: Schedule, tickets, opponent, and everything else you need to know
articles.description: The Phillies are officially heading back to the MLB playoffs, though it feels more like avoiding a disaster than something to be celebrated. Philly clinched the National League’s final wild-card spot ...

articles.title: Phillies will need Game 162 to get into the playoffs, or complete their collapse after another loss to Rays
articles.description: With the Phillies’ 12-1 loss to the Rays, their drawn-out collapse has become a five-alarm fire of humiliation. They will need Sunday to decide their fate.

articles.title: The Phillies are on the verge of the worst collapse in the city’s sports history. That says something.
articles.description: The goal now is to avoid infamy. It is to preserve legacy. It is to summon the last shred of political capital they earned in 2022 and escape from Game 162 with a reason to believe.

articles.title: Phillies move up start time of Sunday's game vs. Rays due to rain
articles.description: The Phillies said the earlier start time should provide the best opportunity to play Sunday’s regular-season finale without interruption.

articles.title: Bill Giles, the former Phillies owner who helped create the Phillie Phanatic, has died at 92
articles.description: Once described as “Philadelphia’s resident combination of P.T. Barnum and Walt Disney,” Mr. Giles got creative trying to attract fans. The biggest draw was the mascot he green lit in 1978.

articles.title: Trea Turner returns to leadoff spot, Bryce Harper to first base as Phillies remain without injured Luis Arraez
articles.description: Arraez remains out with a sprained left ankle. While he's out, Harper could move between first base and right field.
